payload.title: Investigating interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium
payload.description: This workflow explores interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium by comparing paleoclimate model outputs with proxy observations. It employs Empirical Orthogonal Function (EOF) analysis to identify large-scale spatio-temporal patterns. The workflow utilizes various datasets, including the CESM Last Millennium Ensemble, and performs PCA analysis on both model and proxy data. The results are visualized through scree plots and EOF maps, facilitating a comprehensive model-data comparison.
